title: Super Key Binds
description: Changes the look and feel of key binding settings.
body:
⭐ Super Key Binds - Modern Keybinding Menu for Minecraft

Super Key Binds is a completely redesigned keybinding menu, designed with convenience, clarity, and speed in mind. The vanilla keybinding menu is cramped, unreadable, and difficult to navigate—this mod solves all of these proble
